name: flock
description: Build knowledge graphs and explore synthetic social simulations from inside Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Knowledge graphs and social simulations inside Codex.
interface.longDescription: Turn source documents into a cited knowledge graph, simulate synthetic communities in Reddit-like or Twitter-like spaces, and create reports—all from inside Codex. Codex performs language-model reasoning in the user's session. Flock's model-free helper stores the graph and run history in the chosen Codex workspace. No provider API key, external graph service, or separate local web app is required.
defaultPrompt: Use Flock in this Codex workspace to build a source-grounded knowledge graph or run a social scenario simulation. Use the active Codex session for reasoning and keep graph and run data in this workspace. Never ask me for a model API key.
